decisions.reason: The polymer concrete drain housing remains close to the firm's core drainage engineering and system business, so it is more likely to be retained than discontinued.
Floor-level shower drainage is central to the firm's direction toward accessible, low-profile bathroom solutions and should stay in the range.
As the firm's design-led flagship shower drainage line, it is highly strategic and therefore very unlikely to be withdrawn.
The shower element with integrated slope supports easier installation and renovation projects, which fits the firm's value proposition well enough to keep it.
The air-admittance valve is the least distinctive and least central product versus the firm's main shower-drainage focus, so dropping it to free resources is the more likely choice.
